title: Storage Cleaner: Cleanup Phone
summary: Free up space in seconds—clean junk & duplicates with safe one-tap scans.
description:
Where did all your space go? Storage Cleaner breaks your storage down app by app and file by file, then clears what you don't need — with you deciding every delete.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Storage breakdown by app, file type and folder, so you can see where space went
• Junk cleaner: cache, temp files and leftover APKs
• Duplicate photos & videos matched side by side, so you keep the best copy
• Old screenshots and blurry shots you'll never open again
• Large files ranked by size, biggest offenders first
• WhatsApp & media folders tidied without losing what matters
• One-tap quick clean, with a review screen before anything goes

HOW IT WORKS
1) Scan your storage and get the breakdown by app, file type and folder.
2) Open any category to preview what's inside and pick what stays.
3) Clean in one tap, then watch the free-space number climb.

WHY STORAGE CLEANER
• You see the breakdown before you clean, not just a number
• Nothing is deleted without your review
• Works offline, and your files never leave your device
• Small install, light on battery

Perfect for: low-storage alerts, slow phones, or when you need space for photos, videos and updates.

Reclaim your space today. Clean safely with Storage Cleaner.
